structured_output.summary: The calibration validity extension under notes/synthetic_mfx_calib_range_20261104/ is complete and consistent. before.json holds 13 prjdatpsana documents (8 jungfrau_000009, 5 pv_000001) all with run=1, run_end=1; after.json and planned.json hold the same 13 documents with run_end=2 and every other field identical on inspection (IDs, id_data, extpars, comment, timestamps, version). All 13 intent files carry the planned document with run_end=2 and sequential UTC stamps 19:44:54.9 to 19:44:56.8; all 13 response files report HTTP 200 with bodies echoing the updated document. verification.json records 46 selections (23 per run for runs 1 and 2) whose id_doc, id_data and payload SHA256 match the Stage 2 deployment journal entry for the same collection/ctype, and run3_experiment_records_excluded is true. independent_check.json reports 13 exact run_end 1->2 diffs, 23 selections per run, identical IDs/hashes, and script hash matching execution. extend.py's guard is sound: it monkeypatches requests Session.request before any network call, permits only GET or a PUT to one of the 13 journaled ws-kerb URLs with a body equal to the current permitted document, disables redirects, re-reads the live record before each PUT, reads back after each PUT, requires after==planned, uses unmodified calib_constants_all_types for selection, and checks run-3 exclusion with select_doc_in_run_range. Both wu.put code paths (session.put and requests.put) route through Session.request so the guard covers either. No psana core files changed. Two low, non-blocking documentation findings are noted. Seema's own-login acceptance remains outstanding as stated in the README and is out of scope here.
